iti62:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti62:2.3: The faculty of ‘I am about to know what is not yet finally known,’ the faculty of final knowledge, the faculty of one who has finally known.
iti62:4.3:
from the ending
of the fetter–becoming–
there’s the knowledge,
the gnosis of one released
who is Such:
iti62:5.2:
peaceful,
delighting in the peaceful state,
iti62:5.4:
having conquered Māra
along with his mount.
